'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[Withdrawal of United States troops from Afghanistan (2021)|Withdrawal of United States troops from Afghanistan]]; [[Taliban insurgency]]
***[[Bagram Airfield]] is [[Looting|looted]] by locals following the sudden American withdrawal from the airbase, which was conducted without notifying local forces. [[Afghan National Army|Afghan troops]] later cleared the airbase of looters and secured control of it. [https://www.newsweek.com/looters-moved-afghanistans-bagram-airfield-hours-after-us-troops-left-1606385 (''Newsweek'')]
***[[The Pentagon|Pentagon]] spokesperson [[John Kirby (admiral)|John Kirby]] announces that [[United States Secretary of Defense|U.S. Defense Secretary]] [[Lloyd Austin]] has approved a new command to oversee troops who will remain in the country to protect [[diplomat]]s at the [[Embassy of the United States, Kabul|U.S. Embassy]] in [[Kabul]]. The mission will be led by [[Rear admiral (United States)#Rear admiral (lower half)|RDML]] Peter Vasely. [https://www.stripes.com/theaters/middle_east/2021-07-02/us-drawdown-afghanistan-mckenzie-miller-vasely-troops-2033972.html (''Stars and Stripes'')]
***It is reported that, during June, the Taliban captured 700 [[Humvee]]s as well as dozens of [[armored vehicle]]s and [[artillery]] systems from the Afghan National Army as more districts fall under the group's control during their offensive in the north. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/south-asia/afghanistan-taliban-captured-700-military-vehicles-as-fighting-intensifies/articleshow/84073763.cms (''Times of India'')]

**[[Operation Alula]]
***Thousands of captured [[Ethiopia]]n [[Prisoner of war|prisoners of war]] are paraded through the streets of the [[Tigray Region|Tigrayan]] capital of [[Mekelle]] flanked by Tigrayan fighters. Many of the [[Ethiopian National Defense Force|soldiers]] appear to be wounded. Huge crowds form to taunt the captured soldiers. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Transair Flight 810]]
**[[Transair Flight 810]], a cargo flight from [[Honolulu]] to [[Kahului, Hawaii|Kahului]], ditches off the coast of [[Oahu]]. The two pilots are injured. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-57697835 (BBC News)]
*A massive fire breaks out at an undersea gas pipeline which connects to the [[Ku-Maloob-Zaap]] oil field, off the coast of the [[Yucatán Peninsula]]. The fire took five hours to contain. Mexican state-run oil company [[Pemex]], who is in charge of the oil field's operations, orders an investigation into the cause of the fire. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/fire-offshore-pemex-platform-gulf-mexico-under-control-2021-07-02/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]] 
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Indonesia]]
*****The [[National Agency of Drug and Food Control of Indonesia|Food and Drug Authority]] grants an emergency use authorization for the [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.antaranews.com/berita/2244238/bpom-beri-izin-penggunaan-darurat-vaksin-moderna (Antara)]
****[[Indonesia]] reports a record third consecutive day of 24,836 new cases and a record fourth consecutive day of 539 deaths from [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total confirmed cases and death toll to 2.22 million and to 59,534, respectively. [https://health.detik.com/berita-detikhealth/d-5628750/update-corona-ri-2-juli-rekor-lagi-25830-kasus-baru-dan-539-kematian?_ga=2.9123509.1233990.1625063958-36500994.1494122671 (detikHealth)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[India]] surpasses 400,000 deaths from COVID-19, becoming the third country to do so after the [[United States|U.S.]] and [[Brazil]]. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/07/02/india-s-covid-19-death-toll-passes-400-000-but-experts-say-it-s-higher (Euronews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan]]
****[[Pakistan]] receives 2.5 million doses of the [[Moderna]] COVID-19 vaccine from the [[United States]], facilitated through the [[COVAX]] initiative, [[UNICEF]] and the [[Government of Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/india-coronavirus-vaccine-coronavirus-pandemic-business-health-3c943e8ac8cb19e4825acdb904fe7037 (AP)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] reports a record for the third consecutive day of 61 deaths from COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 2,141. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2142287/record-61-covid-deaths-6-087-new-cases (''Bangkok Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Saudi Arabia]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****The [[Saudi Arabia]] [[Ministry of Education (Saudi Arabia)|Ministry of Education]] announces that it will vaccinate students aged 12 and 18. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1887421/saudi-arabia (''Arab News'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bosnia and Herzegovina]]
****[[Bosnia and Herzegovina]] reports its first case of the [[SARS-CoV-2 lineage B.1.617|Lineage B.1.617]] [[SARS-CoV-2 Delta variant|Delta variant]] in a [[Spanish people|Spanish]] woman who visited the Catholic pilgrimage site of [[Medjugorje]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-bosnia/first-case-of-covid-delta-variant-confirmed-in-bosnia-report-idUSKCN2E81XW (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[Portugal]] imposes a curfew from 11 p.m. to 5 a.m. in 19 "very high risk" [[Municipalities of Portugal|municipalities]], including [[Lisbon]] and [[Albufeira]], and 26 "high risk" municipalities, due to the spread of the highly contagious Delta variant. [https://www.theportugalnews.com/news/2021-07-01/curfew-between-11-00-pm-and-05-00-am-in-45-counties/60823 (The Portugal News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a record for the fourth consecutive day of 679 [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|deaths]] from COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 136,565. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2021/07/02/russia-posts-record-coronavirus-deaths-for-fourth-day-running-a74410 (''The Moscow Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Canada]]
****[[Prime Minister of Canada|Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]] receives his second dose of the COVID-19 vaccine. However, Trudeau received the [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine|Moderna]] vaccine for his second dose instead of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|AstraZeneca]] vaccine. [https://globalnews.ca/news/7997681/justin-trudeau-second-dose-moderna-covid-vaccine/ (Global News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
*****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oregon]]
******The [[Oregon Health Authority]] announces that over 70% of adults in [[Oregon|the state]] have received a dose of the COVID-19 vaccine. [https://www.columbian.com/news/2021/jul/02/oregon-reaches-70-percent-covid-vaccination-milestone/ (''The Columbian'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nevada]]
*****The positivity rate for COVID-19 in [[Nevada]] reaches 6%, the highest in the state since March 7. [https://www.reviewjournal.com/news/politics-and-government/nevada/nevada-covid-test-positivity-rate-tops-6-for-1st-time-since-march-7-2392012/ (''Las Vegas Review-Journal'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
****[[COVID-19 lockdowns|Lockdown]] restrictions are lifted in the [[Northern Territory]] after a decline in the number of new COVID-19 cases. [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|Mask]]s will still be required indoors, private gatherings will be limited to 10 people, and gyms will remain closed. Lockdown restrictions are also lifted in regional [[Queensland]], but masks will still be required indoors, and private gatherings will be limited to 30 people. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-07-02/greater-darwin-lockdown-to-be-lifted/100261700 (ABC News Australia)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Fiji]]
****[[Fiji]] reports a record five deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the death toll to 29. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/446084/fiji-covid-19-5-more-deaths-404-new-cases (RNZ)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Colombia]]
***[[Santa Cruz del Islote]], one of the [[List of islands by population density|most densely populated islands on Earth]], becomes the first Colombian territory to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19. [https://www.eltiempo.com/colombia/otras-ciudades/isla-en-cartagena-es-el-primer-territorio-nacional-vacunado-totalmente-600256?utm_medium=Social&utm_source=Twitter#Echobox=1625228325-1 (El Tiempo)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa]]
***[[South Africa]] reports a record 24,270 new cases from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 2.02 million. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-07-02/south-africa-reports-record-24-270-daily-coronavirus-cases (Bloomberg)]

'''International relations'''
*[[European migrant crisis]], [[Belarus–Lithuania relations]]
**[[Lithuania]] declares a [[state of emergency]] amid an increase in the number of undocumented migrants crossing into the country from neighbouring [[Belarus]]. The [[Government of Lithuania]] accuses Belarusian [[President of Belarus|President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] of deliberately trying to destabilize the country by encouraging and allowing refugees, mostly [[Syrians]], to cross the [[Belarus–Lithuania border|border]]. [https://www.politico.eu/article/lithuania-state-emergency-migrants-belarus-border/ (Politico)]
*[[Belarus–Ukraine relations]]
**[[Belarus]] closes its [[Belarus–Ukraine border|border]] with [[Ukraine]] after President [[Alexander Lukashenko]] claims that arms are being smuggled into the country in an attempt by "outside powers" to overthrow his regime, saying that "They have crossed the line. We cannot forgive them". Ukraine denies Lukashenko's claims, and says that closing the border would make its people "suffer". [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-57702516 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
**[[COVID-19 vaccination in Brazil]]
***[[Brazil]] prosecutors open a probe into [[President of Brazil|President]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]] for his role in a scandal involving the [[Covaxin]] vaccine. [https://www.macaubusiness.com/brazil-prosecutors-to-probe-claims-against-bolsonaro-in-alleged-vaccine-graft-case/ (Macau Business)]
*A court in [[Tonga]] sentences the former Minister for Infrastructure and Tourism [[ʻAkosita Lavulavu]] and her husband to six years in prison after the [[Supreme Court of Tonga|Supreme Court]] found them both guilty of obtaining money by false pretenses. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/446053/tongan-mp-and-former-mp-sentenced-to-six-years-jail (RNZ)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Elections in the United Kingdom]], [[2021 Batley and Spen by-election|Batley and Spen by-election]]
**The opposition [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]] narrowly holds the [[West Yorkshire]] constituency of [[Batley and Spen (UK Parliament constituency)|Batley and Spen]] with a reduced majority of just 323 votes, defying expectations of a loss. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-57691543 (BBC News)]
